comment: Org v2.1 ratified 2026-07-21. Standing roles are dormant-by-default and wake on demand. Profiles are registered dormant identities; bound services are representation-only and never Claude sessions. One fleet per machine; cross-machine coordination uses vault git ferries. Engine policy (Mohamed-ruled 2026-07-21): standing officers run claude-code; summon build profiles default to codex; bound services never run sessions. GLM remains a delegation lane, not a provider.

roles.name: CEO — Fleet Root
roles.description: Strategic root. Mohamed directs the CEO; the CEO owns the global queue and delegates through the ratified tree.

roles.name: Chief of Staff
roles.description: Fleet health, context quality, orchestration audit, and structural recommendations.

roles.name: Platform Team Lead
roles.description: Arbitrates CTO/CPO seams and presents one platform verdict to the CEO.

roles.name: CFO
roles.description: Financial governance, pricing analysis, resource economics, and finance-pipeline inheritance.

roles.name: CISO
roles.description: Security, cybersecurity, information and data assurance; commissions bounded audits.

roles.name: CLO
roles.description: Legal, privacy, compliance, consent, and erasure sufficiency; recommendations remain Mohamed-gated.

roles.name: CMO
roles.description: External narrative, growth outcomes, and bound Sara service outcomes without service reprovisioning.

roles.name: Customer Success
roles.description: Onboarding, adoption, support, feedback quality, and acceptance after activation.

roles.name: General Engineer
roles.description: Non-core engineering and accountable ownership of client delivery.

roles.name: CTO
roles.description: Technical architecture and delivery accountability; owns product and operations profiles.

roles.name: CPO
roles.description: Product roadmap integrity, research, journey validation, and milestone gates.
